date_meaning: New prospective review sidecar prepared 5 October for the task begun 4 October; filenames retain the task identifier. Not content of the preserved 3 October PDF, a filing, a priority claim or an earlier public version.
scope: Four explicit representative later-claim comparison scenarios for each of the 199 exact current candidates, with full dependencies and own-feature applications. No exhaustive chronological patent search or final legal/physical determination.

S1.name: Selected source-type or bounded record arrangement
S1.question: Does one qualifying version actually disclose an enabled selected arrangement satisfying this claim's own feature and every inherited limitation?
S1.scope_rule: A present mathematical witness is not an earlier enabled physical embodiment. An attributed source retains its actual specimen, basis, process and observation boundaries.

S2.name: Same elements with changed ratios, structure or state; qualified record-operation variation
S2.question: For the same selected elemental labels, what changed proportions, structure or state are disclosed? For independent record/particle methods, what qualified variation of the same modeled inventory, input or operation is disclosed?
S2.scope_rule: Physical comparisons preserve the selected elemental support and k. A changed ratio/state can fail an exact added restriction while retaining those labels. Independent method comparisons preserve their own categorical and dependency boundaries; corruption/rejection probes are separate notes.

S3.name: Specific selection from the broad catalog
S3.question: Is the selected combined physical or record arrangement specifically taught, rather than only admitted by the generic mathematical or descriptor domain?
S3.scope_rule: An enabled disclosed species can be compared with a broader genus; reverse membership does not automatically disclose every selected species. Record workflows need their complete ordered operations.

S4.name: Added preparation, use, control or recording acts
S4.question: Are additional operative acts, their arrangement and their conditions actually disclosed, including all limitations of the hypothetical later claim?
S4.scope_rule: Product identity, target arithmetic and record fields do not supply every later process/use. Intended-use words and operative method steps require different construction.

legal_source_check_boundary: The 3 October claim review's attributed official source identifiers and principles are preserved. This supplement performs no new law update or exhaustive source graphical review; the dated procedural/counsel review remains separate.

ALLOY.scope: CoCrFeNi/CoCrFeMnNi principal equiatomic feeds, prepared specimens and reported local impurities; complete support and exact equality remain conditional.

GLASS.scope: Selected metallic-glass source/route and six-principal target; present fine-box and below-floor models are current calculations, not source specimen data.

OXIDE.scope: TiO2(B) nominal 1:2 formula, selected nanosheet route; retained surfaces/residuals, source-specific precursor issues and exact binary closure remain qualified.

POLYMER.scope: Su et al. PLLA/PDLA 1:1 feed blend and ideal repeat/conditional chain-end record. Feed mass and nominal repeats are not complete incorporated composition, sequence or topology; source Mn/PDI assignment remains dimensionally unresolved.

HYDROGEL.scope: Source-local PIC/linker operations and response context; present count/topology/record examples remain calculated/proposed.

ELECTRICAL.scope: SWCNT/PEDOT:PSS/PS stock origins, source preparation and percolation context; stock-component targets are not elemental fractions or performed source specimen compositions.

MOLECULAR.scope: Attributed carbamazepine selected connectivity/hydrate source; bulk isolation/mixture proportions and exact retained inventory not established here.

COMPOSITE.scope: Attributed nanotube/epoxy example; loading, constituent identity and whole retained elemental/volume inventory differ.

NUCLEAR.scope: Dated nuclear identifiers/evaluation fields, not an arbitrary isotope material or current/future complete nuclear universe.

PARTICLE.scope: Selected identity/property source locators include searches/limits; table inclusion is not discovery or full system-record implementation.

G01.name: Variable complete elemental inventory
G01.enablement: The simplex defines targets but supplies no general preparation/use route for arbitrary recognized/hypothetical mixtures. [0082]-[0083] show retention and phase-profile constraints rather than a universal process.
G01.novelty: On the complete-actual-support construction, finite recognized-element specimens with at least two elements necessarily have positive normalized atom counts and zeros outside their actual support. Enabled alloy/glass/oxide/polymer/composite species therefore present strong conditional anticipation exposure; 'selected' and 'expressly identified' need construction.
G01.obviousness: Identify any actual physical difference after inventory/basis construction. Pure enumeration or a different descriptive record is not itself a supported materials advance; no completed motivation/expectation analysis is supplied.
G01.definiteness: Resolve whether inventory is a fixed constituent list or all actual positive counts, specimen region/time, and whether 'expressly identified' restricts the product or only its description. 'Comprising' and closed elemental denominator should be explained together.
G01.action: Retain the broad scope as a review catalog; add express construction alternatives, specimen/time boundary and source-limitation charts. Reserve any narrower future material claim for a selected supported physical embodiment.

G02.name: Exact counts 2 through 118
G02.enablement: Exact k supplies a cardinality, not compatible chemistry, preparation, structure, retained inventory or use. Every such claim still permits some hypothetical labels and arbitrary fractions.
G02.novelty: For each exact k, all k actual constituents must be considered; principal-name counts alone do not settle closure. Concrete comparisons exist for k=2,3,4,5,6,7 with impurity/retention qualifications. For other k this review has no demonstrated exact-k comparator.
G02.obviousness: Count selection alone supplies no chemistry-specific reason, success expectation or unexpected result. Evaluate the particular permitted species and all inherited requirements.
G02.definiteness: The integer count is clear, but inherits claim 1's inventory/basis ambiguity. Do not substitute k principal ingredients for k actual elements.
G02.action: For each k retain exact count and explicitly identify whether a cited specimen establishes complete support, principal target only or unsupported hypothetical branch.

G03.name: Exact counts above 118
G03.enablement: With only 118 recognized labels, k>118 necessarily requires at least k-118 unconfirmed labels. No route producing or retaining these entities in a material is provided; this is not routine chemical preparation.
G03.novelty: No enabled comparator for the required hypothetical-constituent material is established here. This absence is not a novelty conclusion, and unperformed enumeration does not disclose an enabled species.
G03.obviousness: No demonstrated production route or reasonable expectation of making the required unconfirmed constituents supports an obviousness conclusion. Mathematical cardinality is not a success expectation.
G03.definiteness: k is numerically clear; hypothetical identifiers retain status. The claim describes a physical material rather than merely an index.
G03.action: Keep as expressly unsupported physical scope, specifying the minimum unconfirmed constituent count; distinguish indexing utility from material utility.
